name: IRFZ44N
source: Infineon IRFZ44NPbF データシート (Rev. 2.1, 2026-08-11)
description: N チャネル パワーMOSFET 55V 49A (TO-220, ピン1=G 2=D 3=S)。10V 駆動。データシート (Infineon) の代表特性から作った等価モデル (レベル1 + 直列抵抗、ボディダイオードつき)

transfer.at: 図 3 (伝達特性の代表特性、VDS = 25 V) の 25 °C

body_diode.at: 図 7 (ソース・ドレイン間ダイオードの順方向の代表特性) の 25 °C

remarks: the table gives VGS(th) min 2.0 / max 4.0 V and RDS(on) max 17.5 mohm (10 V, 25 A) only. Most tick labels are pictures: the axes are placed on the grid lines found with `ds grid` and read with `ds trace` `xt=` / `yt=`; Figure 7's x labels (0.0, 0.6, 1.2, 1.8, 2.4 V) differ from the IRF540N's and were checked on the page drawn at 2 px/pt
transfer: Figure 3 (VDS = 25 V), the 25 C curve (lower than the 175 C one below about 5.5 V, higher above)
rds: Figure 1 (25 C), the second curve from the top (10 V; at 1 V all eight curves are apart: 15, 10, 8 V ... give 78.8, 70.6, 63.5 A) at 0.1, 0.5 and 1 V; the bottom one (4.5 V) at 0.3 V
caps: the table's Ciss 1470, Coss 360, Crss 88 pF typ (VGS = 0, VDS = 25 V, 1 MHz)
body_diode: Figure 7, the 25 C curve (the right one), 0.2 to 100 A; the table's VSD max 1.3 V at 25 A
